$3Saturday Cashback Map

How the Saturday $3 works

Pay with PayLah! at a participating shop on a Saturday and get $3 cashback, credited by the end of the same day.

  1. Scan a NETS QR or PayNow UEN QR. Personal PayNow/PayLah! QR payments don’t count.
  2. Heartland shops, wet markets and coffeeshops show a POSB wobbler. Hawkers show an SGQR code with the PayLah! logo or a PayLah! sticker.
  3. One cashback per day. Redemptions are limited, and the PayLah! home screen shows “FULLY REDEEMED” once they run out.
Map colours
About this map

This is an unofficial finder, not made by or affiliated with DBS or POSB. It was built from:

  • The DBS Saturday Savings participating merchants list, updated 17 Sep 2026
  • OneMap (Singapore Land Authority) and a public postal code dataset, for pin locations
  • URA Master Plan 2019 planning area boundaries
  • LTA MRT and LRT station exit locations

Shops can join or leave the campaign after the list date, and the list itself has typos. Where a postal code in the list didn’t match its street address, the pin follows the street address. 14 addresses couldn’t be confirmed and are placed on the right road near the listed block; these are marked in their details. Shop names are shown as they appear in the list.

Always look for the POSB wobbler or PayLah! sticker at the shop before you pay. The official DBS list and campaign terms take priority over this map.
